Container.Name: PolyStrata-Inkling
Container.Overview: Inkling 2 Mini UD-Q4_K_XL (Unsloth) on the same image as PolyStrata (polystrata:tower, the tower-next build). One RTX 3070: stop PolyStrata before starting this one, and stop this one before starting PolyStrata. Engine config: /data/config/strata-inkling2-mini.json (setup's small-card settings: --attn-requant q5_0 --loop-bf16 --tail-skip 4). Notes: docs/tower/README.md Pass 21 on the cybertiel-family branch.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Config, packs, expert profile. Shared with the PolyStrata container.

Config.Name: Park
Config.Description: Parked conversations spill here (TMPDIR=/park). Keep on /mnt/cache: a disk, not RAM.

Config.Name: TMPDIR
Config.Description: Where strata-poly spills parked conversations (nameless temp files).

Config.Name: STRATA_POLY_MIRROR
Config.Description: 0: no pinned RAM copy of the experts outside VRAM (same speed on Tower, 15 GB less locked RAM).

Config.Name: STRATA_CPU_NO_X4
Config.Description: 1: CPU experts one weight row a call (upstream e7f467548 four-row kernels are 15% slower decode on the 2600X, Pass 20).
